Ongoing updates to the modpack change which weapons may be used prior to or after specific bosses. This is known as a progression lock. If you have not defeated the boss necessary to unlock the weapon (or tool) you are attempting to use, you will do no damage, trigger no effects, and will receive a private message in chat that exclaims
Your [Tier] tool appears unwilling to do damage. Try again after defeating [Pre-requisite Boss]

This does not only apply to weapons crafted from materials like iron, gold, and diamond as seen in the main progression tab, but also weapons from other mods which may be looted or dropped from mobs and structures in the world. This includes Unique Weapons from the Simply Swords mods. This page aims to give a general overview of what weapons may be acquired at various game states. For the sake of simplicity, when discussing weapons made of a single material such as diamond, "weapon" refers to vanilla swords and axes, as well as all Simply Swords versions such as twinblades, glaives, tsai, chakram, and pernach.

For the sake of clarity, a weapon of the tier directly before the current boss is not strictly necessary in order to defeat it. For example, a weapon obtained after the Iron Colossus is perfectly suitable for The Goblin Lord, Arion, or Eldorath depending on a variety of factors. The bosses prior to the Ender dragon have nearly linearly scaling health and do not represent an insurmountable barrier due to regeneration limits or similar mechanics. Given enough time and survivability, one could theoretically defeat any with a pre-Iron Colossus weapon. However, if you are struggling with your current weapon, you might fare better with one you have just unlocked.

Existance on this list is not an endorsement of feasibility nor utility, for example, some items are fairly standard tools (axes for instance) that happen to also be weapons. It's possible to get some weapons earlier than on the list as it was based purely on theorized convenience. Players are encouraged to experiment to their heart's content.
Unless otherwise stated in the source section, weapons are crafted by the player. Items with duplicate names such as lead and steel swords have been identified by the mod
